## What lives here
The shadcn/ui primitives (new-york style), plus four app-specific pieces (EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeletons, StatusPill).

## Conventions
Stock shadcn except `button.tsx` (custom variants) and `sheet.tsx` (resizable). Regenerate the rest with the shadcn CLI.

## Entry points
Imported everywhere.
